properties.summary: Build order item 7. The manual check over the dev_reflow2 family found five facts held twice, one held too high, and two roll-ups drifted. A similarity sweep found a duplicate one time in eight. Anthony kept the duplicate sweep as considered and made a narrower check intent: a record naming another design's record in its text is offered a typed link and flagged when their statuses disagree. The seven findings wait for flo2.io's upgrade.
